title: **Navigation waits for `load`, so one stuck
notes: image hangs a capture.** `gotoSettled` and `login` (`waitForURL` default)
wait for the `load` event before the bounded `networkidle` settle.
`/api/admin/avatar?phone=...` image requests open past commit locally, and
a propose run against production never reached a screenshot. Smallest
step: reproduce with a fixture page whose image never finishes, then
navigate on `domcontentloaded` and bound the wait for `load` like
result: Route navigation and login wait for DOMContentLoaded, then bound load and network-idle settlement concurrently. Document navigation failures still reject. Pending main-document redirects must reach DOM readiness within the settle cap; latest failed redirects reject, while newer successful navigation and same-document history redirects remain valid.
evidence: The real Chromium unfinished-image route fixture timed out before the fix. Targeted navigation, existing CLI login and raw-placeholder tests pass all 22 cases; the fixture covers route navigation, form login with an unfinished image and failed document navigation. Independent review returned no findings. The first complete frozen run exposed a client-auth redirect race (415/416 tests passed). Two additional deterministic pending/aborted redirect regressions failed before their corrections; all eight Chromium navigation cases, ESLint and package typecheck then passed.
